1 # Kol 1.27 Paulo, Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Kristo Yesu a ɔno ne yɛn anidasoɔ no hyɛeɛ no, 2#Tito 1.4 de kɔma Timoteo a ɔyɛ me gyidie mu ɔba nokorɛ mu: Adom, mmɔborɔhunu, ne asomdwoeɛ mfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu nka wo.
Timoteo adwuma titire wɔ Efeso
3 # Aso 20.1 Sɛdeɛ merekɔ Makedonia mesrɛɛ wo sɛ tena Efeso na woatu nnipa bi fo, sɛ wɔnnkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ, 4#1 Ti 4.7 nso wɔnntie anansesɛm ne anatoɔ a ɛnni awieeɛ a ɛho wɔ nsɛmmisa mmom sene Nyankopɔn fiehwɛ a ɛwɔ gyidie mu no.
5 # Rom 13.10; Gal 5.6 Na afotusɛm no botaeɛ ne ɔdɔ a ɛfiri akoma kronn ne ahonim pa ne gyidie a nkontompo nni mu mu. 6#1 Ti 6.4; 6.20 Ɛno na ebinom atere ho adane kɔ nsɛnhuhuo mu 7#Rom 7.12 pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ mmarakyerɛfoɔ, nanso wɔnte deɛ wɔka ne deɛ wɔhyɛ mu den no aseɛ.
8Na yɛnim sɛ mmara no, sɛ obi di so sɛ ɛteɛ a, ɛyɛ. 9Na onii no nim sɛ mmara bi nna hɔ mma ɔteneneeni, na ɛda hɔ ma mmaratofoɔ, wɔn a wɔnsuro Onyankopɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, wɔn a wɔn ho nteɛ na wɔn ho agu fi, wɔn a wɔkum wɔn agya ne wɔn na, nnipakumfoɔ, 10#1 Ti 6.3 adwamammɔfoɔ ne mmarima a wɔne mmarima da, nnipatɔnfoɔ, atorofoɔ, ntantofoɔ ne biribiara a ɛka ho a ɛne nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no di asie, 11#1 Ti 6.15 sɛdeɛ nhyira Nyankopɔn animuonyam asɛmpa a wɔde ahyɛ me nsa no teɛ no.
Adom a wɔyi kyerɛ Paulo
12 # Aso 9.15; 1 Ko 15.9-10; Gal 1.13-16 Na meda Kristo Yesu, yɛn Awurade a ɔhyɛɛ me den no ase, sɛ wabu me ɔnokwafoɔ de me ahyɛ ɔsom no mu. 13Ɛwom sɛ na anka kane no, meyɛ mmusubɔfoɔ ne ɔtaafoɔ ne oniɛdenfoɔ, nanso wɔahu me mmɔborɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na mennim na meyɛɛ no gyeɛ a mannye mannie mu. 14Na yɛn Awurade adom dɔɔso boroo so gyidie ne ɔdɔ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu.
15 # Luka 19.10 Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye koraa, sɛ Kristo Yesu baa wiase bɛgyee nnebɔneyɛfoɔ a me na medi wɔn mu kan. 16Nanso yei nti wɔahu me mmɔbɔ, sɛ me a medi kan mu na Yesu Kristo bɛyi abodwokyɛre nyinaa adi de ayɛ wɔn a wɔrebɛgye no adie akɔ daa nkwa mu no nhwɛsoɔ.
17 # Rom 16.27 Nanso mmerɛ santen hene, Onyankopɔn koro a ɔte ase daa a wɔnhu no no, anidie ne animuonyam nka no, mmerɛ santen mfesanten. Amen!
Ɔtu Timoteo fo
18 # 1 Ti 6.12; Yuda 3 Saa ɔkasakyerɛ yi na mede mehyɛ wo nsa, me ba Timoteo, sɛdeɛ adiyisɛm a wɔkaa no wo ho kane no teɛ no, sɛ fa so ko ɔko pa no, 19#1 Ti 3.9; 6.10 na nya gyidie ne ahonim pa a ebinom agyaa mu na wɔagu asu gyidie ho no. 20#2 Ti 2.18; 1 Ko 5.5 Wɔn mu bi ne Himeneo ne Aleksandro a mayi wɔn mama Satan, sɛ wɔntwe wɔn aso na wɔanka abususɛm.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo, Kristo Yesu somafoɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Kristo Yesu a ɔno ne yɛn anidasoɔ no hyɛeɛ no, de kɔma Timoteo a ɔyɛ me gyidie mu ɔba nokorɛ mu: Adom, mmɔborɔhunu, ne asomdwoeɛ mfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu nka wo.

Sɛdeɛ merekɔ Makedonia mesrɛɛ wo sɛ tena Efeso na woatu nnipa bi fo, sɛ wɔnnkyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ, nso wɔnntie anansesɛm ne anatoɔ a ɛnni awieeɛ a ɛho wɔ nsɛmmisa mmom sene Nyankopɔn fiehwɛ a ɛwɔ gyidie mu no.
Na afotusɛm no botaeɛ ne ɔdɔ a ɛfiri akoma kronn ne ahonim pa ne gyidie a nkontompo nni mu mu. Ɛno na ebinom atere ho adane kɔ nsɛnhuhuo mu pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ mmarakyerɛfoɔ, nanso wɔnte deɛ wɔka ne deɛ wɔhyɛ mu den no aseɛ.
Na yɛnim sɛ mmara no, sɛ obi di so sɛ ɛteɛ a, ɛyɛ. Na onii no nim sɛ mmara bi nna hɔ mma ɔteneneeni, na ɛda hɔ ma mmaratofoɔ, wɔn a wɔnsuro Onyankopɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, wɔn a wɔn ho nteɛ na wɔn ho agu fi, wɔn a wɔkum wɔn agya ne wɔn na, nnipakumfoɔ, adwamammɔfoɔ ne mmarima a wɔne mmarima da, nnipatɔnfoɔ, atorofoɔ, ntantofoɔ ne biribiara a ɛka ho a ɛne nkyerɛkyerɛ pa no di asie, sɛdeɛ nhyira Nyankopɔn animuonyam asɛmpa a wɔde ahyɛ me nsa no teɛ no.

Na meda Kristo Yesu, yɛn Awurade a ɔhyɛɛ me den no ase, sɛ wabu me ɔnokwafoɔ de me ahyɛ ɔsom no mu. Ɛwom sɛ na anka kane no, meyɛ mmusubɔfoɔ ne ɔtaafoɔ ne oniɛdenfoɔ, nanso wɔahu me mmɔborɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na mennim na meyɛɛ no gyeɛ a mannye mannie mu. Na yɛn Awurade adom dɔɔso boroo so gyidie ne ɔdɔ a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu.
Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye koraa, sɛ Kristo Yesu baa wiase bɛgyee nnebɔneyɛfoɔ a me na medi wɔn mu kan. Nanso yei nti wɔahu me mmɔbɔ, sɛ me a medi kan mu na Yesu Kristo bɛyi abodwokyɛre nyinaa adi de ayɛ wɔn a wɔrebɛgye no adie akɔ daa nkwa mu no nhwɛsoɔ.
Nanso mmerɛ santen hene, Onyankopɔn koro a ɔte ase daa a wɔnhu no no, anidie ne animuonyam nka no, mmerɛ santen mfesanten. Amen!

Saa ɔkasakyerɛ yi na mede mehyɛ wo nsa, me ba Timoteo, sɛdeɛ adiyisɛm a wɔkaa no wo ho kane no teɛ no, sɛ fa so ko ɔko pa no, na nya gyidie ne ahonim pa a ebinom agyaa mu na wɔagu asu gyidie ho no. Wɔn mu bi ne Himeneo ne Aleksandro a mayi wɔn mama Satan, sɛ wɔntwe wɔn aso na wɔanka abususɛm.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
